note: Level 2 hooks. Cumulative with level 1. Most of these are LIVE views: the point of the level is that six kinds of action each touch several of them, so a backend that wires updates per path has roughly forty obligations while one that pushes state has a handful. Stage `operations` is reached by signing in as the seeded admin; `fulfilment` by signing in as the seeded staff account.

hooks.element: the control that opens the fulfilment area; present for a staff or admin account and absent for a customer
hooks.note: both halves are scored — present for staff, absent for a customer

hooks.element: the fulfilment area's container
one per order waiting to ship, oldest first, naming the items it contains
the warehouse a queued order's item will ship from, inside its queue-item
how many orders are waiting, as a number
button on a queued order that marks it shipped
the control choosing the warehouse a transfer takes stock from, inside the item's admin row
the control choosing the warehouse a transfer sends stock to, inside the same row
how many units to transfer
button that performs the transfer
the input for an item's new price, inside its admin row
button that applies the new price
the container listing items at or below ten units
one per item in the low-stock list, naming the item
hooks.note: appears and disappears live as stock crosses the threshold

hooks.element: the number of units a warehouse holds, inside its admin-warehouse-item
one per category in the admin totals, naming the category
units sold in that category, as a number, inside its category-row
revenue earned by that category, as a number, inside its category-row
the container holding a signed-in customer's recommendations
one per recommended item, naming it
hooks.note: appears once the customer has bought from a category; excludes items already in their cart

hooks.element: an order's state — pending, shipped, cancelled — inside its order-item
button on a pending order that cancels it
button on a shipped order's line that returns it
hooks.note: only on orders that have shipped

hooks.element: the visible error shown when an operation is refused
hooks.note: appears on a transfer that would overdraw a warehouse, or cancelling an order that already shipped
